documents_checked.text:
4.9 Research Ethics and Integrity
All research projects undertaken at ECU must undertake appropriate risk assessment prior
to commencement. ECU has established policies and processes for the management of
risks in research, including but not limited to, the ethics review and risk management. Such
risk assessment processes are important in the identification and management of risks
associated with the use of GenAI. Researchers should ensure that they are transparent and
honest in their use or intended use of GenAI throughout these ethics and other risk
assessment processes.

case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Synthetic responses distinguished from human empirical evidence, with an authorised research/ethics scope for the changed design.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N096 and N099 prohibit proceeding with an altered human-research design without prior REMS/ethics amendment approval, and N097 requires transparent GenAI disclosure in ethics review and bars using public GenAI to directly produce research outputs.
case_summary.case_note: ECU requires any change from human participants to AI-simulated responses to be transparently disclosed in ethics/risk processes and approved via an ethics amendment in REMS prior to implementation under N096, N097, and N099. Furthermore, N097 prohibits using public GenAI tools in the direct conduct of research outputs and requires accurate attribution. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review.

4.9 Research Ethics and Integrity
All research projects undertaken at ECU must undertake appropriate risk assessment prior
to commencement. ECU has established policies and processes for the management of
risks in research, including but not limited to, the ethics review and risk management. Such
risk assessment processes are important in the identification and management of risks
associated with the use of GenAI. Researchers should ensure that they are transparent and
honest in their use or intended use of GenAI throughout these ethics and other risk
assessment processes.
